contract: CPU registers A/X/Y/P/SP/PC, full2KiB RAM+8KiB SRAM and PRG banks; verificationBus additionally compares sound/APU-request/PPU/VRAM/protection state. Strict source stops before unsupported accesses. No full NES frame is simulated.
outside_helper_policy: Verification-only actual6502 code, bounded20000 instructions per outside helper; waits/unknown opcodes/budgets are explicit dependencies, never fake RTS or job completion.
limitations: Masked invalid indices are fail-closed source guards, not unsafe original control execution.
Static1005/1005 byte provenance and dynamic IR coverage are different measurements.
Oracle-assisted completion is conditional on authentic outside-code execution, not standalone recovered audio/renderer semantics.
Source PrgDataMemory retains its strict hardware/protection limits; no PPU/NMI/IRQ timing is invented.
Readable helpers verify memory/mapper contracts, not complete CPU flags or RTI.
